description: Icebreaker bingo for developers — coding habits, IDE preferences, and developer culture

squares.text: Uses dark mode
Has Googled a syntax error today
Has more than 10 browser tabs open right now
Prefers spaces over tabs
Has copy-pasted from Stack Overflow this week
Has named a variable 'temp', 'foo', or 'x'
Uses keyboard shortcuts instead of the mouse
Has left a TODO comment in code for months
Has more than 3 unfinished side projects
Has restarted their computer to fix a bug
Can touch-type without looking at the keyboard
Has at least 2 different IDEs or editors installed
Uses version control for personal projects
Can recite at least one HTTP status code from memory
Has written a unit test that only tests the happy path
Has customised their IDE theme or font
Has debugged by adding print or console.log statements
Knows what vim is (bonus points: can exit it)
Has pushed directly to main or master
Has used AI to help write or review code
Owns or covets a mechanical keyboard
Has pair-programmed in the last month
WILDCARD: Teach the group a keyboard shortcut — right now!
WILDCARD: Show your terminal or IDE theme to someone nearby
WILDCARD: Name a programming language you want to learn next
